GRASS-FED & GRAIN FINISHED
The quality of Nieslanik Beef's meat is a direct reflection of the care with which we treat our cattle. 

In the winter and spring, our herd feeds on a mixture of hay we grow and put up each summer. During summer and early fall, Nieslanik cattle graze high nutrient vegetation in the beautiful high country surrounding Carbondale, Colorado. They come home happy and healthy in the fall and we finish them on our unique mixture of homegrown grasses and grains. They are full sized and ready to go after their second summer in the high country and their fall finishing at home on Nieslanik Ranch. Our cattle are an Angus/Simmental mix.

Our family is focused on building and maintaining a healthy herd around the clock... 365 day's a year. These efforts result in fantastic living conditions for our cattle.... and the high quality beef products Nieslanik Beef brings to market.

Watch our heritage series to learn about a year in the life of our cattle.

Delivery

We deliver every Tuesday from Craig driving south toward Aspen. If you are along the route, we can meet you at a predetermined location. 

Please note: we are on a tight delivery schedule.  If you are not at the meeting place, will not be able to wait and you will have to pickup your order the following day at our ranch.

Like the beef? You'll love the view

The ranch is located within walking and biking distance of downtown Carbondale (approximately one mile). If you've never seen the views from White Hill in Carbondale we highly recommend the experience. Take an evening stroll, or ride, or drive and enjoy the unspoiled view of a Sopris Sunset across the Nieslanik Family's conserved lands. Bring the family! Bring a camera!
